author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam shares a unique piece of space hardware memorabilia: a 1:1 reproduction of the capsule panels on Project Mercury's spacecraft. Made by Luna Replicas, this stamped panel looks like it was taken right off of John Glenn's iconic Friendship 7 capsule, down to the hand-painted nose art depecting the spacecraft's name!

Luna Replicas Mercury Spacecraft shingle: https://lunareplicas.com/collections/flight-gear/products/mercury-spacecraft-1-1-reproduction-shingle?variant=47012839031008

Shot and edited by Joey Fameli
Music by Jinglepunks
